target_population: every station worldwide that can be lawfully and reproducibly accessed without paid data access

identity_policy.canonical_station_id: stable opaque identity derived from one immutable root provider alias; later provider aliases are explicit crosswalk bindings and do not mutate the canonical id
identity_policy.cross_provider_deduplication: explicit provider crosswalk/evidence only; geographic proximity is never sufficient identity evidence
identity_policy.location_history: resolved non-overlapping epochs used by canonical topology, with source alias and source-artifact digest; a provider snapshot never becomes a resolved location merely because it is newer
identity_policy.crosswalk_application: cross-provider aliases are applied only from explicit station-specific digest-bound relation evidence referencing an already resolved immutable root alias; provider catalog revision digests live on provider metadata snapshots, so routine provider refreshes update provenance without rebinding identity; conflicting ownership still fails closed and removing a relation is forbidden while resolved history or current provider metadata depends on that alias
identity_policy.provider_location_snapshots: each immutable station revision carries at most one current metadata snapshot per bound provider alias; overlapping or conflicting provider coordinates remain explicit snapshots, while prior snapshots remain in prior content-addressed catalog revisions rather than accumulating without bound in the current object

storage_policy.catalog: content-addressed bounded catalog shards referenced by manifest; each current station object keeps one provider-location snapshot per alias while prior snapshots remain in superseded immutable shard revisions, so no global station table or unbounded per-station metadata log is required in memory
storage_policy.observations: content-addressed provider/time/variable/spatial partitions with explicit supersession or tombstones
storage_policy.ingestion: idempotent by artifact digest; source revisions append lineage rather than overwrite prior artifacts
storage_policy.coverage: derived from active manifest references; coverage v2 carries geographic bounds for adaptive catalog shards, propagates those bounds to observation partitions by spatial-partition identity, and reports unresolved geographic partitions explicitly rather than requiring consumers to reopen station records

providers.scale_path: complete ghcnd-stations.txt and ghcnd-inventory.txt provider artifacts feed bounded content-addressed catalog shards; execution environments invoke the exact native curl binary directly for provider HTTPS transfer and pass completed immutable bytes into Climate parsers; yearly observations use provider by-year artifacts rather than per-station requests
providers.access: NCEI HTTPS archive and Common Access Data/Search Service REST APIs
providers.license_or_access_constraints: NOAA public data; source-specific restrictions and flags remain part of provenance
providers.update_semantics: daily updates plus periodic reconstruction; NCEI assigns unique daily versions and values/flags can be revised, so responses used as evidence must be captured and digested
providers.revision_identity: catalog, inventory, and by-year inputs bind the exact provider URL plus final captured SHA-256 and byte count; HTTP/TLS/redirect/transfer behavior belongs to the explicitly invoked native curl executable outside Climate source, and published observation partitions carry the captured compressed-artifact SHA-256 with explicit supersession or tombstone lineage

providers.access: NCEI HTTPS bulk archive and data access applications
providers.license_or_access_constraints: NOAA public data; source and quality-control attributes remain part of provenance
providers.update_semantics: Version 1 is updated daily; immutable inputs pin the exact station-list or bulk archive artifact digest, and yearly archive filenames carry product version plus creation date
providers.revision_identity: station-catalog and annual archive inputs preserve exact provider URL plus captured artifact digest; Climate validates GHCNh version/data-year/creation-date archive identity but owns no HTTP client or transfer wrapper
providers.scale_path: the GHCNh station list and explicitly versioned annual archive URLs define provider identity; execution environments perform HTTPS transfer with their exact native transport and pass completed immutable artifacts into Climate's catalog/PSV parsers and federation routing
